about: Brussels Airport-Zaventem railway station is beneath the Brussels Airport terminal. Trains connect the airport with Brussels-Central in about 18 minutes.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Brussels Airport-Zaventem station is on Level -1 beneath the terminal, with escalator and lift access to the halls. The journey to Brussels-Central takes about 18 minutes. Journeys to and from the airport usually carry a €6.90 Brussels Airport Supplement, often already included in the ticket.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Luggage lockers outside the terminal on Level 0 are accessible around the clock. A size M locker costs €10 per 24 hours, with a minimum charge of 24 hours; additional hours cost €2 per hour.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the terminal, including arrivals, before and after security, and at boarding gates. Some areas, such as lounges, have a separate free network. Connecting means accepting the network’s terms of use.
